name: YHA Scarborough
accommodation: Private rooms (en-suite or shared facilities); 46 beds in normal operation
suitableFor: Solo travellers, budget surfers and small groups
beachAccess: 15 minutes' walk from Scalby Mills and North Bay beach
confirmedFeatures: Drying room, laundry, cycle store, licensed bar, garden, BBQ area, lounge with woodburning stove
overview: YHA Scarborough sits in The White House on Burniston Road, about a mile and a half north of the town centre. It offers private rooms, a drying room, laundry and a licensed bar, with a large car park and secure bike shed. Scalby Mills and the North Bay beach are around 15 minutes away on foot.
surfTripFit: A budget-friendly base at the quieter north end of North Bay, and the drying room helps with wet wetsuits.
